summary: Iteration 2 — Groveno Fresh admin panel + referral + SSE. Backend: 80/80 pytest tests pass (65 regression + 8 referral basics + 2 referral reward flow + 4 SSE unauthorized + 1 SSE end-to-end). Frontend: all 13 admin panel pages load, sidebar navigation (10 nav items) works, login/logout token flow works, protected route redirects to /login when unauthenticated. Dashboard renders 4 stat cards, 3 channel cards, Recharts line chart and Recent Orders table. Products page shows 10 seeded products, search filter works, Add Product navigates to /products/new form. Categories page shows categories with btn-add-category present. Orders page filters + row-click navigates to /orders/:id with order-status-dropdown visible. Users list → User detail shows credit-amount/credit-desc/credit-submit inputs. Pickup Points, CLs, Wallet, Reports all render. Reports has Recharts bars (4), pie sectors (5) and btn-export-csv. Express Pickup page shows 'Live' badge. Backend referral flow validated end-to-end: user B applies A's code → B places first order → A gets +10 coins + CoinTransaction {source:'referral', amount:10, expiresAt≈90d}. Second order does NOT credit A again. SSE endpoints return 401 without/with wrong token; with valid token they emit 'snapshot' event + 'location' event when POST /orders/:id/location-update fires.

minor.issue: CoinTransaction created for referrer looks correct, but CoinTransaction and other Mongo docs still expose raw _id/__v in JSON responses (pre-existing minor from iter 1).

Comment-only lines (: ping) are sent every 20s — good. HTTP client timeout must be > 5s to reliably catch first snapshot event through the Cloudflare/ingress path (~1-2s buffering). Not a bug, but SSE consumers should set connect timeout separately from read timeout.

issues: Non-critical console warnings: 'React Router Future Flag Warning' for v7_startTransition and v7_relativeSplatPath — recommend opting into future flags on RouterProvider or Routes config.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: opt-in to react-router v7 future flags to silence warnings.
Optional (carry-over from iter 1): strip _id/__v from JSON responses via toJSON transform; normalize Mongoose ValidationError to 400 via errorHandler.
critical_code_review_comments: referral.controller.js `maybeCreditReferrer` mutates user & referrer sequentially without a DB transaction — with concurrent duplicate first-orders it could race and credit twice. In dev/single-instance MongoDB this hasn't triggered, but under load with retries this could be a concurrency bug. Consider a compare-and-set on firstOrderPlaced (User.updateOne({_id, firstOrderPlaced: {$ne: true}}, {$set: {firstOrderPlaced: true}}) and only credit if modifiedCount === 1).

referral.controller.js sets `referrer.coinsExpiresAt = expiresAt` unconditionally — this may shorten an existing longer expiry if the referrer already has coins expiring later. Consider taking the max of current and new.
stream.controller.js verifies JWT but does not enforce that admin token has role === 'admin' from a fresh Admin doc lookup for each event (only at connect time). Acceptable for short-lived tokens.
location.controller.js emits ORDER_STATUS_CHANGED with plain string status — customer stream filters on orderId only. Fine, but include `status` in the event payload consistently (already does).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows (login, protected routes, navigation across 10 pages, dashboard, products, categories, orders, users, user-detail, pickup-points, CLs, wallet, reports, express-pickup)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (80 tests). Referral + SSE-specific tests: /app/backend/tests/test_referral_and_stream.py. Frontend uses VITE_API_URL from /app/frontend/.env pointing at https://delivery-coins.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin token stored in localStorage under key 'groveno_admin_token'. SSE endpoints require ?token= query param (EventSource limitation). Dashboard, Products, Categories, Orders, Users pages all confirmed working. Express Pickup shows 'Live' badge (SSE connected). Referral reward is credited synchronously (awaited) in order.controller.js.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All backend endpoints (including new referral + SSE) and all admin panel UI flows work correctly.
